stem_book: A piece of uniform paper (figure 1) is in the form of a square of side 2a. Its two right-hand corners are folded to make it appear like figure 2, both corners being put together at the centre O of the square. If O is taken to be (0, 0) with the x-axis pointing right, the centre of mass of the new system will be at (a) (−a/8, 0) (b) (−a/6, 0) (c) (a/12, 0) (d) (−a/12, 0)
work: each folded triangle (area a²/2) centroid moves from x = 2a/3 to a/3 ⇒ Δx_cm = 2·(a²/2)(−a/3)/(4a²) = −a/12, y symmetric = 0
